members.name: Stefan Pazin
members.bio: Stefan builds and maintains websites, shops and the automations behind them. Over nine years he has worked across WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify and custom code, from small business sites to SaaS platforms built from scratch. Today his focus is AI automation: content and catalogue pipelines with the Claude API and n8n, technical SEO and integrations that save teams hours every week.

members.name: Novak Guslov
members.bio: Novak combines strategic marketing planning with the delivery of large-scale retail campaigns. His expertise covers price image campaigns, agency coordination and international marketing project management. In digital marketing he focuses on eCommerce, content strategy, SEO and customer behaviour analysis — with particular industry knowledge in beauty, personal care and health, and experience across the DACH region.
